method: Separate post-draft reading against actual frozen identity, four native raw logs and independent timing readback, MI/novice/vignette/ancillary receipts, current policy, rights disposition, replay amendment and three fresh panel votes.
score_reason: Concrete release observations with explicit limits; the structured receipt format necessarily repeats scope and identity.
confidence_reason: Editorial self-assessment, with no calibrated human or authorship inference.

examples.cue: Concrete observation and its scope are explicit
examples.impact: Makes the evidence and remaining limitation visible without inferring acceptance or general scientific validity.

science_gate_reason: No new scientific result or default change is asserted; bounded checks do not become general recovery or nominal-coverage claims.
facts_gate_reason: Archive identity, status, timing measures, counts, disclosures and approvals compared with the actual retained sources and current state; incomplete replay history is explicit.
references_gate_reason: Exact DOI identity checked against retained current primary Crossref metadata; policy files and dated rights records are distinguished from licence grants or legal opinions.
calibration_status: Protocol examples and earlier technical receipts were seen; no held-out evaluation.
